exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the present simple or present continuous.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni present simple yoki present continuous shakliga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
31-betdagi 5-mashqning davomi (12–15 bandlar).

ZAMON BELGILARI:
  every morning, sometimes → PRESENT SIMPLE
  now, today               → PRESENT CONTINUOUS

items.whyUz:
'every morning' → PRESENT SIMPLE (kundalik tartib).
'George' — birlik 3-shaxs → driveS.

'now' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'he' → IS + walking (oddiy -ing).

'sometimes' → PRESENT SIMPLE (odat).
'Julie' — birlik 3-shaxs → wearS.
'a skirt' = yubka.

'today' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS (bugun sodir bo'layotgan hodisa).
Ob-havo gaplarida ega DOIM 'it' → IS + snowing.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the present simple or the present continuous.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni present simple yoki present continuous shakliga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
MAYKNING KANADADAN YOZGAN XATI (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Dear Steve,
  I AM WRITING to you from Canada. I AM on holiday with my
  brother. We ARE VISITING my parents in beautiful Montreal.
  It usually SNOWS here this time of year, but the weather is
  lovely and the sun IS SHINING today.
  My brother and I ARE very busy this week. There is a big
  family dinner on Tuesday and we ARE TRYING very hard to have
  everything ready. My brother IS SLEEPING now and I AM
  LISTENING to music. We ARE HAVING a really good time.
  See you soon.
  Yours, Mike

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Hurmatli Stiv,
  Men senga Kanadadan yozyapman. Akam bilan ta'tildaman.
  Biz go'zal Monrealda ota-onamникига mehmonga kelganmiz.
  Yilning bu paytida bu yerda odatda qor yog'adi, lekin
  ob-havo ajoyib va bugun quyosh charaqlayapti.
  Akam bilan men bu hafta juda bandmiz. Seshanba kuni katta
  oilaviy ziyofat bo'ladi va biz hamma narsani tayyorlashga
  juda harakat qilyapmiz. Akam hozir uxlayapti, men esa
  musiqa tinglayapman. Biz juda yaxshi vaqt o'tkazyapmiz.
  Tez orada ko'rishguncha.
  Hurmat bilan, Mayk

DIQQAT — 'BE' FE'LI:
  'be' HOLAT fe'li — u -ING SHAKLIDA ISHLATILMAYDI.
  'I am on holiday' (TO'G'RI) — 'I am being on holiday' XATO.

items.whyUz:
Xat yozish — hozir sodir bo'layotgan ish → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'write' → 'writing' (-e TUSHDI).

items.textEn: I 2) ............ (be) on holiday with my brother.
items.whyUz:
'be' — HOLAT fe'li, -ing shaklida ishlatilmaydi.
'I AM on holiday' = ta'tildaman.
'be ON holiday' — 'on' predlogi shart.

items.textEn: We 3) ............ (visit) my parents in beautiful Montreal.
items.whyUz:
Ta'til davomida davom etayotgan ish → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'we' → ARE + visiting.
DIQQAT: 'visit' da undosh IKKILANMAYDI — urg'u birinchi bo'g'inda (VIS-it).

items.textEn: It usually 4) ............ (snow) here this time of year.
items.whyUz:
'usually' → PRESENT SIMPLE (har yili takrorlanadigan holat).
Ega 'it' — birlik → snowS.

items.textEn: ... but the weather is lovely and the sun 5) ............ (shine) today.
items.whyUz:
'today' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS (bugungi holat).
'the sun' — birlik → IS + shining (-e TUSHDI).
4 va 5-bandni solishtiring: odatda qor yog'adi, LEKIN bugun quyoshli.

items.textEn: My brother and I 6) ............ (be) very busy this week.
items.whyUz:
'be' — holat fe'li.
'My brother and I' = biz → ARE.
'busy' = band.

items.textEn: There is a big family dinner on Tuesday and we 7) ............ (try) very hard to have everything ready.
items.whyUz:
Bu hafta davom etayotgan ish → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'try' → 'trying' (-y O'ZGARMAYDI -ing oldidan).
'try hard' = juda harakat qilmoq.

'now' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'my brother' — birlik → IS + sleeping.

8-band bilan bir paytda sodir bo'lyapti → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'I' → AM + listening.

'have a good time' = yaxshi vaqt o'tkazmoq — bu HARAKAT,
shuning uchun -ing shakli MUMKIN.
'we' → ARE + having (-e TUSHDI).
DIQQAT: 'have' egalik ma'nosida bo'lsa -ing OLMAYDI.

exercises.instructionEn: Tick the correct sentences, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
HAR JUFTLIKDA FAQAT BITTASI TO'G'RI.
VAQT IFODASIGA qarab tanlang:

  PRESENT SIMPLE belgilari:
     every weekend, every morning, every evening,
     in her free time, usually, always, sometimes

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS belgilari:
     today, at the moment, now

KITOBDA BERILGAN: 1a to'g'ri.

options: a  It is raining heavily today.
b  It rains heavily today.
items.answer: a  It is raining heavily today.
items.whyUz: Kitobda BERILGAN javob. 'today' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

options: a  Frank plays football every weekend.
b  Frank is playing football every weekend.
items.answer: a  Frank plays football every weekend.
items.whyUz:
'every weekend' → PRESENT SIMPLE (odat).
'Frank' — birlik 3-shaxs → playS.

options: a  The sun is shining at the moment.
b  The sun shines at the moment.
items.answer: a  The sun is shining at the moment.
items.whyUz: 'at the moment' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

options: b  Jessica plays the drums in her free time.
a  Jessica is playing the drums in her free time.
items.answer: b  Jessica plays the drums in her free time.
items.whyUz:
'in her free time' = bo'sh vaqtida — bu ODAT → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'the drums' = barabanlar. Cholg'u asbobi oldida THE shart.

options: a  James usually wears a shirt and tie.
b  James is usually wearing a shirt and tie.
items.answer: a  James usually wears a shirt and tie.
items.whyUz:
'usually' → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'a shirt and tie' = ko'ylak va galstuk.

options: b  They are doing their homework now.
a  They do their homework now.
items.answer: b  They are doing their homework now.
items.whyUz:
'now' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'do homework' = uy vazifasini bajarmoq → 'are DOING'.

options: a  Charles catches the bus to work every morning.
b  Charles is catching the bus to work every morning.
items.answer: a  Charles catches the bus to work every morning.
items.whyUz:
'every morning' → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'Charles' — birlik 3-shaxs → catchES (-ch bilan tugagani uchun -ES).
'catch the bus' = avtobusga chiqmoq, avtobusni ushlamoq.

options: a  The children are making a snowman at the moment.
b  The children make a snowman at the moment.
items.answer: a  The children are making a snowman at the moment.
items.whyUz:
'at the moment' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'the children' — ko'plik → ARE.

options: b  It is raining in Prague today.
a  It rains in Prague today.
items.answer: b  It is raining in Prague today.
items.whyUz:
'today' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'It rains in Prague' (todaysiz) — umumiy fakt bo'lardi.

options: a  I listen to music every evening.
b  I am listening to music every evening.
items.answer: a  I listen to music every evening.
items.whyUz:
'every evening' → PRESENT SIMPLE (odat).
'I' bilan fe'l ASOS shaklida — -s QO'SHILMAYDI.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct form of the verbs below.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: watch, have, make, play, wear, go

MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):
  Every winter my sister and I make a snowman. We WEAR heavy
  jackets and gloves and GO outside. Our mum WATCHES us from
  the window and our dad MAKES hot chocolate for everybody.
  Sometimes our mum comes outside and PLAYS in the snow with
  us. We HAVE a great time!

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Har qish singlim bilan men qorbobo yasaymiz. Biz qalin
  kurtka va qo'lqop kiyib, tashqariga chiqamiz. Oyim bizni
  derazadan kuzatadi, dadam esa hammaga issiq shokolad
  tayyorlaydi. Ba'zan oyim ham tashqariga chiqib, biz bilan
  qorda o'ynaydi. Biz ajoyib vaqt o'tkazamiz!

BUTUN MATN PRESENT SIMPLE'DA — 'Every winter' shuni ko'rsatadi.

DIQQAT — EGA BIRLIKMI YOKI KO'PLIKMI:
  we           → fe'l asos shaklida (wear, go, have)
  our mum      → fe'l + S (watches, plays)
  our dad      → fe'l + S (makes)

items.whyUz:
'wear heavy jackets' = qalin kurtka kiymoq.
'we' — ko'plik → fe'l ASOS shaklida ('wears' XATO).

'go outside' = tashqariga chiqmoq.
Ega hali ham 'we' → asos shakl.

items.textEn: Our mum 3) ............ us from the window ...
items.whyUz:
'watch us from the window' = derazadan bizni kuzatmoq.
'our mum' — birlik 3-shaxs → watchES (-ch → -ES).

items.textEn: ... and our dad 4) ............ hot chocolate for everybody.
items.whyUz:
'make hot chocolate' = issiq shokolad tayyorlamoq.
'our dad' — birlik 3-shaxs → makeS.

items.textEn: Sometimes our mum comes outside and 5) ............ in the snow with us.
items.whyUz:
'play in the snow' = qorda o'ynamoq.
'our mum' — birlik → playS (unli + y → faqat -S).
DIQQAT: 'comes' bilan bir xil egaga tegishli — ikkalasi ham -s oladi.

'have a great time' = ajoyib vaqt o'tkazmoq.
'we' — ko'plik → asos shakl ('has' XATO).

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with the correct form of the verbs in brackets.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni qavsdagi fe'llarning to'g'ri shakli bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):
  It's Sunday today. It is summer and we are all at the beach.
  Mum IS SUNBATHING at the moment and dad IS READING a book.
  My sister ISN'T SWIMMING now. She IS HAVING coffee with a
  friend. I AM WEARING my new swimming-costume and I AM MAKING
  a sandcastle. Everyone IS HAVING fun and IS ENJOYING the
  great weather!

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Bugun yakshanba. Yoz va biz hammamiz plyajdamiz. Oyim ayni
  paytda quyoshda toblanayapti, dadam esa kitob o'qiyapti.
  Singlim hozir suzmayapti. U dugonasi bilan qahva ichyapti.
  Men yangi cho'milish kiyimimni kiyganman va qum qal'a
  yasayapman. Hamma zavqlanayapti va ajoyib ob-havodan
  huzur qilyapti!

BUTUN MATN PRESENT CONTINUOUS'DA —
'at the moment' va 'now' shuni ko'rsatadi.

DIQQAT — 'EVERYONE' BIRLIK:
  Everyone IS having fun ('everyone are' XATO).

items.whyUz:
'at the moment' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'Mum' — birlik → IS + sunbathing (-e TUSHDI).
'dad' — birlik → IS + reading (oddiy -ing).

'not' berilgan → INKOR: IS + NOT = ISN'T.
'swim' → 'swimming' (m IKKILANADI).

'have coffee' = qahva ichmoq — bu HARAKAT → -ing MUMKIN.
'she' — birlik → IS + having (-e TUSHDI).
'I' → AM + wearing (oddiy -ing).
'I' → AM + making (-e TUSHDI).

'everyone' — ma'nosi ko'plik, lekin GRAMMATIK jihatdan BIRLIK → IS.
'have fun' = zavqlanmoq (harakat) → -ing mumkin.
'Everyone are having' XATO.

Ega o'zgarmagan ('everyone') → IS + enjoying.
'enjoy' → 'enjoying' (-y O'ZGARMAYDI).

exercises.instructionEn: Rewrite the sentences with the underlined words in the plural, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Tagiga chizilgan so'zlarni ko'plikka aylantirib, gaplarni qayta yozing, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI IKKI NAMUNA:
  1  Do you like that book?
     Do you like THOSE BOOKS?
  2  This boy loves playing football.
     THESE BOYS LOVE playing football.

BIRLIKDAN KO'PLIKKA O'TISHDA NIMA O'ZGARADI:

  1) KO'RSATISH OLMOSHI:
       this  → these   (bu → bular, yaqin)
       that  → those   (u → ular, uzoq)

  2) OT: ko'plik shakliga o'tadi (kitob → kitoblar)

  3) FE'L: agar ega ko'plikka aylansa,
     3-shaxs -S TUSHADI:
       loves → love

DIQQAT — 2-NAMUNADA UCH O'ZGARISH BOR:
  This → These,  boy → boys,  loves → love

points.en: Do you like that book? → Do you like those books?
points.uz: Anavi kitob senga yoqadimi? → Anavi kitoblar senga yoqadimi?
points.noteUz:
Kitobda BERILGAN 1-namuna.
that → THOSE, book → BOOKS.
Fe'l o'zgarmaydi — ega 'you' o'zgarmagan.

points.en: This boy loves playing football. → These boys love playing football.
points.uz: Bu bola futbol o'ynashni yaxshi ko'radi. → Bu bolalar futbol o'ynashni yaxshi ko'rishadi.
points.noteUz:
Kitobda BERILGAN 2-namuna.
This → THESE, boy → BOYS, loves → LOVE (-s TUSHDI).
Ega ko'plikka aylandi → fe'ldan -s tushadi.

Mashqning qolgan bandlari (3–10) 33-betda davom etadi.

wordFormation.introUz: 32-bet — holat fe'llari, 'have' iboralari va ko'rsatish olmoshlari.

groups.explanationUz: Bu fe'llar harakat emas, HOLATNI bildiradi.
'have' bu iboralarda 'ega bo'lmoq' emas, boshqa ma'noda.

items.derived: We are having a good time.

groups.explanationUz: Masofa va son bo'yicha to'rt shakl.
Ma'lum tovushlar bilan tugagan fe'llarga -es qo'shiladi.

patterns.exampleEn: It usually snows here this time of year. George drives to work every morning.
patterns.exampleUz: Yilning bu paytida bu yerda odatda qor yog'adi. Jorj har kuni ertalab ishga mashinada boradi.
patterns.explanationUz: Takrorlanadigan ish va odat → Present Simple.

patterns.formula: today / now / at the moment / this week + Present Continuous
patterns.exampleEn: The sun is shining today. We are trying very hard this week.
patterns.exampleUz: Bugun quyosh charaqlayapti. Bu hafta biz juda harakat qilyapmiz.
patterns.explanationUz: Hozir yoki shu davrda davom etayotgan ish → Present Continuous.
Qavsda 'not' berilgan bo'lsa — inkor shakl kerak.

patterns.exampleEn: Everyone is having fun and is enjoying the great weather!
patterns.exampleUz: Hamma zavqlanayapti va ajoyib ob-havodan huzur qilyapti!

patterns.formula: this + ot (birlik) → these + otlar (ko'plik);  that → those.
patterns.exampleEn: This boy loves football. → These boys love football.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu bola futbolni yaxshi ko'radi. → Bu bolalar futbolni yaxshi ko'rishadi.

patterns.exampleEn: I am on holiday. My brother and I are very busy.
patterns.exampleUz: Men ta'tildaman. Akam bilan men juda bandmiz.
patterns.explanationUz: 'I am being on holiday' XATO — 'be' holat fe'li.
